crossRefs.note: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.
crossRefs.keyword: to speak. Heb. and spake and called. the rock Rimmon

crossRefs.note: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.
I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will…
Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Rimmon
people.line: Rock where Benjamites fled after battle

translations.web: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.
translations.bsb: Then the whole congregation sent a message of peace to the Benjamites who were at the rock of Rimmon.
translations.kjv: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably
translations.asv: And the whole congregation sent and spake to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace unto them.
